note: F-Call binds a same-file call's result for the evaluation of the argument that reads it, and for nothing after (chant#3610). inside.ts reads p only inside makePair's argument and folds. after.ts and before.ts add plain, which reads p in an object literal at a declarator, outside any argument. That read is J1's rejection whichever declarator comes first, so both files run: an argument that resolved p earlier does not leave it bound.
